# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie Pye is noted as being fat. Anne Shirley contrasts her physique with that required of a fairy queen, noting that fairy queens must be slender.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Josie is widely regarded as disagreeable, malicious, and sharp-tongued. She is prone to sulking when she does not get her way and often makes unkind or taunting remarks to her peers. She lacks imagination and shows a defiant, boastful streak when challenged or when competing with others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033)_

## History

During her time at Avonlea school, Josie Pye frequently engaged in dares and rivalries with her classmates. On one occasion, she successfully walked a board fence after being dared by Anne Shirley, and subsequently dared Anne to walk the ridgepole of a roof, which resulted in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. During preparation for a school concert, Josie became sulky when she was not cast as the fairy queen in a dialogue because of her size. Later, she caused a three-month rift with Julia Bell after repeating a rude comment about Julia's reciting style to Bessie Wright. Josie won first prize for her knitted lace at an exhibition. She later studied for the entrance examinations and attended Queen's Academy, taking Second Class work for education's sake rather than out of necessity to earn a living.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)_
